senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; denom. of כִּיס)bag, bolster, cushion.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:2">Mikv. X, 2</cite> <he>הכר והכ׳ של עור</he> mattress and pillow cases of leather; <he>כ׳ עגולה</he> a round cushion (closed all around).

<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 8:3">Ber. VIII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 6:3">Tosef. ib. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 5:3">V</cite>), 3 <he>על הכ׳</he> on the cushion (whereon the diner reclines); a. fr.—Pl. <he>כְּסָתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:2">Kil. IX, 2</cite>; a. fr.—<cite ref="K00584"><he>כִּסִּיּוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="K00594"><he>כִּיסִּ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Zavim 4:4">Tosef. Zab. IV, 4</cite> <he>מוטל על ה׳ כ׳</he> stretched on five (separated) bolsters; <cite ref="Mishnah Zavim 4:4">Zab. IV, 4</cite> (Talm. ed. <he>כסאות</he>, ed. Dehr. <he>כסיות</he>).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17:6">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:19:1">Koh. R. to III, 19</cite> <he>לתחתיתו כ׳</he> thick flesh of the ischium; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 969:1">Yalk. Koh. 969</cite> <cite ref="K00911"><he>כסות</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: הכ׳, Hakkeseth, surname of one Ben Tsitsith. Gitt. l. c. [כסת, Sifra B’ḥuck. Par. 2, ch. V, v. כָּסַח.]
